Metal rolls are the consumable working element of rolling mills — cast or forged in alloy steel, spheroidal graphite iron, high-chrome iron, adamite, graphite steel, indefinite-chill or tungsten carbide — which shape billets, blooms and slabs into finished long and flat steel; because they wear continuously, they are replaced on average every 5-10 weeks, making demand a consumable annuity that CRISIL describes as 'perfectly and …

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Automotive segment expected to remain fastest-growing end-user category due to rising growth of electric vehicles.
- Rising adoption of automation in manufacturing expected to drive market growth.
- Government's 'Make in India' initiative cited as boosting the manufacturing industry and creating a positive business environment.
- Increasing exports of forging products cited as a demand driver.
- Increasing Foreign Direct Investment expected to boost market growth.
- Continued development of new railway lines cited as a demand driver.
- Raw material price increase in the last quarter, attributed to the Iran-US war impact, negatively affected turnover.
- Company enters the new financial year with a robust order book, per the Chairman's message.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Focus on operational efficiency, market diversification, product innovation, and strengthening global presence.
- Continued investment in advanced technologies and value-added products.
- Strategic focus on operational excellence, high-capacity utilisation and cost-optimization.
- Investing in energy-efficient heating technologies, waste-heat recovery systems, and scrap recycling pipelines as part of a sustainability push.
- R&D focus on pioneering closed-die forging techniques to minimize material wastage and shorten product development cycles.
- Building deep engineering capabilities and expanding global export footprint while maintaining financial discipline.
- Pursuing RDSO approval to enter Elastic Rail Clip supply to Indian Railways as a new non-automotive vertical.
